summary: Mission Walk is a below-market-rate condominium development at 330 and 335 Berry St, built under the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency's Affordable Homeownership Program; this building (335 Berry St) was completed in 2009 per DataSF Assessor records, with its BMR units among the 131 across both addresses allocated by a lottery in January 2009.

milestones.text: Below-market-rate purchase applications open for the 131 condo units at 330/335 Berry St ahead of a January 2009 lottery, while the buildings are still under construction
